system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Each configuration declaratively defines agent prompts, tool access, backbone models, and inter-agent topology, executed by a lightweight runtime interpreter
system_prompt_style.note: Prompts are generated/mutated per task by the meta-model and rendered from templates in src/prompts/templates/.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: we employ CodeAgent from SmolAgent on BBEH and Work-Bench, and SWE-Agent on SWE-Bench
env_context_strategy.note: Underlying base agents (SWE-agent, mini-swe-agent, smolagents) explore the repo with tools.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: is consolidated into a summary via an LLM
context_compaction.note: Evolution traces are consolidated; no explicit history-truncation code shown in provided evidence.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: we employ CodeAgent from SmolAgent on BBEH and Work-Bench, and SWE-Agent on SWE-Bench
tool_call_format.note: smolagents CodeAgent writes code actions; SWE-agent/mini-swe-agent issue shell commands.

tool_count.note: Tool sets are per-configuration and evolved (src/tools/registry.py not shown); no fixed default count in evidence.

tool_schema_source.note: Tool modules are hand-authored Python stubs for WorkBench domains.

protocol_standardization.note: No mcp/a2a files appear anywhere in the 141-path file tree.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: selects initial candidates from a pool, evolves them through feedback-conditioned operators, evaluates them with a reward function, and updates the pool and memory for future tasks
loop_primitives.note: Evolutionary loop over candidate configurations; base agents run ReAct-style loops; verifier/LLM-judge feedback drives repair.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The meta-model analyzes the execution trace to identify the primary performance bottleneck, then produces an updated configuration
planning_granularity.note: Configurations are structured, but no per-task plan object is stored by default.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: we focus on col-laborative MAS organized in hierarchical and peer-to-peer structures
multi_agent_topology.note: Topology is evolved per task; pool includes debate, peer_review, majority_vote, chatdev, metagpt configs.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: an edge (vi,vj)∈E specifies that the outputs ofvi are (part of) the inputs of vj
delegation_mechanism.note: Work passes along a communication DAG; closest to message passing between agents.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: automatically generates MAS configurations for each task
human_in_loop.note: No confirmation/approval hooks appear in scripts or runner evidence.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: a system must maintain an explicit task state that summarizes execution progress and solution quality
short_term_state.note: Quote is from the other same-named EvoMAS paper; in the amazon-science repo the MAS configuration plus candidate set is the run state.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: MEMORY_PATH | (auto) | Explicit memory JSON path; empty = `dataset/<subset-path>/memory_<ts>.json`
long_term_memory.note: Experience memory of past tasks/configs persisted as JSON across runs; pool also grows.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Continue a prior memory file instead of starting fresh
state_persistence.note: Memory/pool files can be reloaded; not a mid-task conversation resume.

self_verification.evidence_quote: uses an LLM-as-judge metric as a proxy reward signal
self_verification.note: src/dataset/local_swe_evaluator.py and swe_evaluator.py run benchmark tests; src/utils/verifier.py.

retry_policy.note: n evolution steps produce k+n candidate executions per task.

rollback.evidence_quote: clones 15 upstream projects into `dataset/repos/` at the pinned commits listed in `src/dataset/repos.txt`
rollback.note: Repos are locked (RepoLock) and reset to pinned commits between tasks; inferred.

termination_condition.note: Evolution ends after n steps; base agents also declare completion.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Cost(C) =T+α·L combines the total token usage T and wall-clock latencyL
cost_controls.note: Reward penalizes cost; meta-model assigns models per agent role (model routing) from AGENT_MODELS palette.

timeouts.evidence_quote: from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, TimeoutError as FuturesTimeoutError
timeouts.note: Per-task future timeouts; lock acquisition timeout default 300s.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: use_docker: bool = False,  # Default to no Docker for EvoMAS

filesystem_access.note: Local execution on host filesystem; repo access serialized by file locks.

network_policy.evidence_quote: AWS Bedrock models use the standard credential chain
network_policy.note: No network restriction configuration appears in the repo evidence.

permission_model.note: No approval or allowlist layer in EvoMAS itself; underlying SWE-agent blocklist may apply.

tracing.note: Execution traces are recorded and fed to the meta-model; logging module used throughout.

replayability.note: Seed configurable but no replay path found in the evidence.

guardrails.note: No guardrail/filter module in the file tree.

target_domain.evidence_quote: covering reasoning, software engineering, and tool-use tasks
